text:
priya: heads-up — enabled FP8 fastpath for awq+gptq combo on L40S canary pool, seeing subtle quality drift on long-prefix summarization tests (consistent across seeds).
liam: ugh. can you paste a failing example + config? is this only on L40S or H100 too? :thinking_face:
priya: repro snippet — small prompt (few-shot) then long prefix (~1.5k tokens) -> summaries lose topic anchors. only on L40S so far. command we used: ```runtimectl canary --pool l40s-canary --model orion-20b-awq-gptq --enable fp8_fastpath --quant hybrid_awq```
olivia: logs from the run: ```WARNING kv-cache: tile_misalignment detected at step 512
TRACE fp8: scale_clip=0.00012 per_channel=true fallback=none
METRIC rouge_l: baseline=0.412 canary=0.398 delta=-0.014```
jen: that delta is small but consistent — could be rounding noise accumulating in longprefix KV indices. did we change tiling/stride heuristics when enabling the fastpath?
liam: yes — fastpath switches to 64x64 tiling on L40S to improve GEMM locality. we've seen misaligned prefix lengths cause KV offset insertions when seq%tile != 0. should be guarded but maybe an edge case in eviction path.
marco: odd combo: AWQ per-channel scales + GPTQ weight fudges + FP8 kernel accumulator truncation. any chance the per-channel scaling quantization is leaking a bias term when tiling boundary falls inside certain heads?
priya: plausible. reproduced locally with smaller model: toggling per_channel -> per_tensor removes the regression. so scaling granularity interacts here.
olivia: quick mitigation — disable fp8_fastpath on longprefix routes and fall back to hetero-int8 path. can we add routing rule in the console?
liam: yes we can add a route: ```if request.prefix_tokens > 1024 and model==orion-20b-awq-gptq -> model_variant: orion-20b-int8-safe``` but want a root fix.
jen: options: 1) patch kernel to align KV writes to base stride (force atomic tile writes) 2) adjust quant scaling handshake at layer boundaries (apply cross-tile correction) 3) runtime: detect non-zero tail and fall back.
marco: I'd vote 2) first — less perf impact and addresses quantization interaction. could add a tiny correction factor per-head computed from precomputed calibration corpus.
priya: ok can we do a small experiment: run calibration correction on a 1k-sample prompt set and compare rouge/bleu + latency. I'll kick off jobs.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment updated — l40s-canary pool: orion-20b-awq-gptq fp8_fastpath toggled -> partial rollback on longprefix-route applied. (ui: https://console/redwood/deploys/3467890123) :white_check_mark:
liam: thx. follow-up: if we see nondet on H100 too, add ticket to runtime for atomic tile write checks. assigning to liam and marco.
priya: filing context ticket with repro + reduced testcase. will add the per_tensor/per_channel diff artifacts. thanks all. :heart:
